input_messages.content: Hi! I have a flight coming up from Boston to Minneapolis, and I’d like to make some changes to my reservation. Can you help me with that?
Sure! My user ID is chen_lee_6825 and the reservation ID is YAX4DR.

I’d like to upgrade the class for all passengers on my reservation to business class. Also, I want to add two checked bags under my name, and I have Gold membership. Can you let me know if there are any fees for these changes?

Thanks for breaking down the costs. Since the total upgrade fee for both passengers is over my budget, can I just upgrade myself and my companion Noah to business class if the cost for just the two of us is $650 or less? If not, then please upgrade only Noah to business class and keep me in economy. I’d still like to add the two checked bags under my name. Let me know what’s possible!

Yes, please go ahead and upgrade only Noah to business class and keep me in economy. I’d also like to add the two checked bags under my name. You can use the card I have on file for the payment. Let me know once it’s all set!
Yes, that’s correct. Please proceed with those changes. Thank you!
That’s perfect, thank you for your help! I don’t need anything else right now. ###STOP###
